NVDA.text: Nvidia was essentially flat, down about 0.1%, as it proved resilient during an AI-chip pullback led by Applied Materials and Broadcom; no distinct Nvidia-specific catalyst was confirmed.

AVGO.text: Broadcom fell about 5.9% as Applied Materials' post-earnings selloff reignited concern that lofty AI-chip expectations leave little room for error, pulling high-valuation semiconductor shares lower.

TSM.text: TSM fell about 1.0% with the broader semiconductor pullback after Applied Materials' upbeat outlook still disappointed elevated AI expectations; no fresh TSM-specific catalyst was confirmed.

ASML.text: ASML slipped about 0.2% but held up better than U.S. equipment peers as Applied Materials' selloff pressured the chip-equipment group; no distinct ASML-specific catalyst was confirmed.

KLAC.text: KLA fell about 2.7% as Applied Materials' post-earnings decline pressured semiconductor-equipment shares and highlighted how elevated AI expectations can punish even solid results; no fresh KLA-specific catalyst was confirmed.

INTC.text: Intel fell about 2.0% with the broader chip selloff as Applied Materials' reaction revived concern about stretched AI expectations, while weaker retail-sales data and Middle East tensions weighed on risk appetite.

MU.text: Micron rose about 2.3%, extending its memory-stock rally as Sandisk's long-term outlook and expectations for sharply higher DRAM and NAND pricing reinforced optimism around the memory cycle.

DDOG.text: Datadog rose about 1.3%, extending its rebound from the prior week's earnings-driven selloff; no fresh company-specific catalyst was confirmed Friday.

META.text: Meta fell about 0.9% with the broader market's modest retreat as weak retail-sales data and renewed Middle East tension tempered risk appetite; no distinct Meta-specific catalyst was confirmed.

PLTR.text: Palantir fell about 2.8% during a session in which investors showed renewed sensitivity to high AI valuations; no fresh Palantir-specific catalyst was confirmed in contemporaneous reporting.

SPCX.text: SpaceX slipped about 0.9% with no confirmed operating catalyst; Reuters reported retail holders turned net sellers Friday as investors continued digesting post-IPO ownership disclosures and expanded share supply.
